package_info.package_name: Imageless Malicious Repository (Downloader/eBook Phishing/Website SEO campaigns)
package_info.why_malicious: These repositories are intentionally created without container images but with malicious metadata designed to lure users into phishing scams or to distribute malware. The campaigns exploit Docker Hub’s trust and searchability to spread harmful links and content, often at massive scale, with no legitimate software purpose.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Repository metadata contains links such as: 'Download eBook here: http://malicious-phishing-site.com' or 'Get the latest software: http://malware-downloader.com'
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: When a user browses or searches for repositories, the metadata displays phishing or malware download links, leading users to external malicious sites.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Repository metadata is used to distribute links to phishing or malware sites, not to describe legitimate container images.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal Docker Hub repositories contain technical descriptions of container images and usage instructions, not external download or phishing links.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate repositories may link to official documentation or project homepages, but not to unrelated download or phishing sites.
key_indicators: Metadata contains external links to non-official, suspicious domains

attack_chain.action: Malicious actor creates a large number of imageless repositories with enticing metadata containing phishing or malware links.
attack_chain.leads_to: Users discover these repositories via search or browsing.

attack_chain.action: User views repository metadata and is lured by the promise of eBooks, software, or other resources.
attack_chain.leads_to: User clicks on the malicious link.

attack_chain.action: User is redirected to a phishing or malware site, potentially entering credentials or downloading malicious files.
attack_chain.leads_to: Credential theft, malware infection, or further compromise.

behavioral_signatures: Repositories with no container images but with metadata containing external links
High-volume creation of repositories with similar metadata patterns
Repository descriptions promising eBooks, software downloads, or unrelated resources
file_indicators: README or description fields containing URLs to non-official domains
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP/HTTPS requests to known phishing or malware domains listed in repository metadata
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor Docker Hub for repositories lacking container images but containing external links in metadata fields. Flag repositories with descriptions or READMEs that include URLs to non-official, suspicious, or blacklisted domains. Detect high-volume or automated creation of such repositories. Alert on user access to these repositories or on outbound network requests to domains found in their metadata.
